title: Release Recording Allowance on Short Sales — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
Release recording instruments — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

Release recording allowance: on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, it forms part of the short-sale closing deductions.

The release recording allowance is USD 48.00 for each of three instruments (the lender's mortgage, the Secretary's second mortgage and the trustee's certification) for a HECM whose occupancy profile under the Occupancy and Residency Certification product is a Living Trust Certification, and USD 48.00 for each of two instruments (the lender's mortgage and the Secretary's second mortgage) for any other HECM; a Summit loan takes no adjustment under this rule.

| Loan | Instruments | Release recording allowance |
|---|---|---|
| HECM, occupancy profile a Living Trust Certification | 3 | USD 144.00 |
| HECM, any other occupancy profile | 2 | USD 96.00 |
| Summit loan | — | no adjustment under this rule |

**Basis question.** *How many instruments does a HECM under a Living Trust Certification occupancy profile take?* Three: the lender's mortgage, the Secretary's second mortgage and the trustee's certification, at USD 48.00 each.
